source: Read-only block-state capture from New World (2), aoemod:plains_dimension, authored basement beside player spawn (-1797,62,-1938)
connections: Three-wide doorways between neighboring rooms; three gates at pen entrances. No openings through the outside perimeter except the six mining shafts. The smith keeps its side workstations and connects through its inner neighboring room.
lighting: Each room has five hanging lanterns: center and four two diagonal steps inward from wall corners. Three longitudinal hallway lantern rows maintain at least block light 8 at floor-air cells. Normal standing and wall torches emit 15.
legacy: Existing v1/v2/v3 piece NBT retains its original geometry and door positions; newly generated mansions use v4. Only an explicit replacement command updates the saved manual placement record.
captureScope: Block states only; no player data, inventories or entity NBT copied. Existing user saves and configs remain untouched.
